visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a blue patterned short-sleeved shirt and matching shorts stands on a green lawn next to a woman in a beige jumpsuit. They are both holding the hands of a small toddler girl in a yellow shirt. The setting is a sunny outdoor park with large green trees and a clear blue sky in the background. (2) The camera cuts to a view from behind a person's head looking at the family. The man and woman let go of the toddler's hands. The woman waves her hand, and the toddler walks toward her. (3) The woman picks up and hugs the toddler as the man watches, looking disappointed. A pink ball sits on the grass nearby. (4) A yellow Labrador dog on a red leash runs across the frame from right to left. The woman continues holding the toddler. (5) The family resets their position for a second trial. The man and woman hold the toddler's hands again. They release her, and the toddler starts to walk forward. (6) The toddler walks past the man and woman toward the dog and two young boys standing off-camera to the right. The man stands with his arms raised in a dramatic pose of despair as the scene turns to grayscale with a 'dead' effect. (7) Close-up shot of the toddler crouching down to pet the Labrador dog which is lying on the grass with an orange ball.
